## GEMSDOE32 `0.2778`: what can and cannot be inferred

The prompt's `0.2778`, `0.3195`, and `0.4413` are **user-provided claims/snapshots**, not organizer-confirmed receipts in this repository. A previous pinned-source review of the GEMSDOE32 page found that the page labels H33-2-B2 as unscored; see [`REVIEW_376A8469.md`](REVIEW_376A8469.md) and its source audit. Thus the requested `0.2778` cannot be treated as a verified competition result or a reproducible causal experiment.

The most defensible explanation is mechanistic, not causal proof: H33-2-B2 inherits a fault-aligned dotted structure and removes selected catalogue-near dots, reducing redundant prediction mass while keeping many points near mapped fault geometry. The project’s local distance-weighted Tversky surrogate can reward this balance because truth coverage saturates locally while excess predictions contribute false-positive mass. This could explain why a sparse/catalogue-conditioned descendant outperformed broader alternatives **if** the supplied score claim is accurate. It does not show discovery of unmapped faults or geothermal vents; nor does it imply that additional thinning is always beneficial. The counterexample test in `tests/test_metric_and_policy.py` rejects a universal “closer dots always help” rule.

The internal **HOLDOUT-DTI** value above is not comparable to, or a prediction of, the claimed organizer score. Repeatedly optimizing one holdout also incurs adaptive-selection bias; a future selection should preserve a locked outer spatial test and reserve it from feature/threshold tuning.

### Top-candidate gate before implementation

Rank 1 (Landsat thermal persistence) is selected only as the next *research question*, not as a built lane. Before any model implementation, a data-only preflight must enumerate Landsat scenes intersecting the exact competition footprint, confirm product band/QA metadata, acquisition season/time span, no-cost/data-use terms, and enough cloud-free observations for the proposed seasonal residual. If that fails, do not promote a substitute based on speculation. Before any dot placement, separately compare the candidate surface to the registry using the user-set correlation and within-3-pixel rules; no such surface test was run here. The final-dot stage would also have to pass: the existing full-footprint-positive witness makes any nonempty same-grid dot raster score literal forward overlap `1.000`, so the unchanged final-dot gate currently blocks promotion. This is distinct from the unrun surface test.
